mapper.select: SELECT fms.id AS id, fms.tenant_id AS tenantId, fms.factory_id AS factoryId, fms.shift_date::text AS shiftDate, fms.shift_code AS shiftCode, fms.shift_start_ts AS shiftStartTs, fms.shift_end_ts AS shiftEndTs, fms.shift_duration_ms AS shiftDurationMs, fms.metrics AS metrics, fms.calculation_data AS calculationData, fms.device_count AS deviceCount, fms.is_finalized AS isFinalized, fms.calculation_status AS calculationStatus, fms.calculated_time AS calculatedTime, fms.calculation_source AS calculationSource, fms.data_completeness AS dataCompleteness, fms.recalculated_at AS recalculatedAt, fms.recalculation_reason AS recalculationReason, fms.recalculation_count AS recalculationCount, fms.created_time AS createdTime, fms.updated_time AS updatedTime FROM biz_device_mgmt.factory_metrics_shift fms WHERE fms.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND fms.factory_id = #{factoryId} AND fms.shift_date = #{shiftDate}::date AND fms.shift_code = #{shiftCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT fms.id AS id, fms.tenant_id AS tenantId, fms.factory_id AS factoryId, fms.shift_date::text AS shiftDate, fms.shift_code AS shiftCode, fms.shift_start_ts AS shiftStartTs, fms.shift_end_ts AS shiftEndTs, fms.shift_duration_ms AS shiftDurationMs, fms.metrics AS metrics, fms.calculation_data AS calculationData, fms.device_count AS deviceCount, fms.is_finalized AS isFinalized, fms.calculation_status AS calculationStatus, fms.calculated_time AS calculatedTime, fms.calculation_source AS calculationSource, fms.data_completeness AS dataCompleteness, fms.recalculated_at AS recalculatedAt, fms.recalculation_reason AS recalculationReason, fms.recalculation_count AS recalculationCount, fms.created_time AS createdTime, fms.updated_time AS updatedTime FROM biz_device_mgmt.factory_metrics_shift fms WHERE fms.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND fms.factory_id = #{factoryId} AND fms.shift_date >= #{startDate}::date AND fms.shift_date <= #{endDate}::date AND fms.is_finalized = true ORDER BY fms.shift_date DESC, fms.shift_code ASC
